description.fun: A Jigglypuff with fangs, wild hair and a terrible singing voice: where Jigglypuff sings lullabies, Scream Tail just screams. A paranormal magazine claimed it could be a Jigglypuff from a billion years ago. It floats rather than walks, and its long ponytail may echo the hollow head crests some dinosaurs used to make loud calls.
description.guide: A Fairy and Psychic-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Scarlet, said to be either an ancient relative of Jigglypuff or a version of it from a parallel timeline. It is aggressive and loud, the opposite of the gentle, singing Jigglypuff.
description.tagline: A fanged, unkempt Jigglypuff that screams instead of singing
